name: 30wr-10step-adjudication-strategy
description: 30 Wetherell Road 10-Step Adjudication & Company Identity Analysis Pipeline

step.name: s01-company-identity-privity
step.prompt: Analyze Companies House filing 11099300 for Red Square Group Ltd and confirm correct contracting entity vs legacy names.

step.name: s02-statutory-debt-validation
step.prompt: Validate Payment Certificate 23 under s.110/111 HGCRA 1996 for £4,297.13 net (£5,156.56 gross).

step.name: s03-delay-event-matrix
step.prompt: Extract all employer-caused delay events between Oct 2024 and Jan 2025 and map against contract completion date.

step.name: s04-variations-pricing-ledger
step.prompt: Construct 37-variation itemized schedule and apply agreed contractual rates and daywork rates.

step.name: s05-lba-statutory-demand
step.prompt: Draft 7-day Letter Before Action (LBA) with statutory late payment interest and compensation costs.

step.name: s06-riba-anb-nomination
step.prompt: Prepare RIBA Notice of Adjudication and request for adjudicator nomination to RIBA ANB.

step.name: s07-referral-notice-drafting
step.prompt: Draft formal Referral Notice and append documentary evidence exhibits 01-18.

step.name: s08-jurisdiction-defense-prep
step.prompt: Pre-empt jurisdictional challenges (e.g. residential occupier exemption under s.106 HGCRA 1996 per Bryen & Langley).

step.name: s09-tcc-enforcement-readiness
step.prompt: Prepare CPR Part 8 claim form and witness statement template for High Court summary enforcement.

step.name: s10-settlement-strategy
step.prompt: Formulate without-prejudice negotiation bounds, timing of Calderbank offer, and ADR options.
